Requires: an Expo account, `npx eas login`, and `npx eas build:configure` to create
the project ID. The first iOS build also needs an Apple Developer account (US$99/yr)
and the first Android build a Play Console account (US$25 once).
A dev client, so the app can be run on a real device against Metro. This is the
profile that unblocks the airplane-mode drill: three sign-ins with the radios
off, then reconnect, then confirm exactly three events landed and no duplicates
after a forced double flush. That drill has been run against the database by a
script; it has never been run on a device, which is the only place the SQLite
outbox and a real network transition both exist.
